_comment: MCP servers for assistants that talk to the hexapod services.
Bearer values are ${VAR} references resolved from the caller's environment at
connect time; the launcher loads them from the Keychain. No token lives here.
robot_lab is Robot Lab v2 (hexapod_lab2.server): tools lab_status, list_runs,
get_run, list_learnings, list_plans, queue_protocol, import_experiment, plus
list_experiments/get_experiment aliases that also accept old lab experiment ids.
